_note: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence — IEEEtran in Computer-Society journal mode.
name: IEEE TPAMI (journal)
preamble: % two-column float discipline (first dogfood: figure* stranded after the references without it)
running_head: IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON PATTERN ANALYSIS AND MACHINE INTELLIGENCE
review: single-anonymous by default; double-anonymous on justified request (editor's discretion)

limits.note: 12 formatted double-column pages incl. references and bios; submissions may run to 18, but every page past 12 bills USD 220 (IEEE CS overlength policy, verified 2026-07)

notes: compsoc journal mode changes abstract/title layout - do not fight it
widths measured from IEEEtran (10pt journal compsoc): \columnwidth 252.945pt = 3.5in = 88.9mm, \textwidth 517.935pt = 182.0mm - and confirmed by the IEEE author center (resolution-and-size)
IEEE graphics guidance: figure type ~9-10pt at final size; raster >300dpi (color/grayscale), >600dpi (line art); vector preferred
double-column floats: \begin{figure*}[tb], never bare [t]; dblfloatfix + the preamble tuning keep them from stranding past the references
template verified 2026-07: [10pt,journal,compsoc]{IEEEtran} + IEEEtran.bst is still what the IEEE Template Selector serves for TPAMI; the blind render is OPT-IN here (single-anonymous default)
figures must survive B&W print; Okabe-Ito + redundant encoding covers this
IEEEtran class and bibliography style ship with TeX Live / MiKTeX
